name: token-budget
description: Use for all agent work to minimize needless context, model calls, retries and total token cost.

name: documentation-ledger
description: Use on every meaningful project task to record decisions, code changes, tests, quality evidence and handoff.

name: project-intake
description: Use when a project starts or its requirements change to define scope, risks and acceptance criteria before coding.

name: stack-selection
description: Use before a new project's technology selection or architectural migration; justify stack based on actual requirements.

name: architecture-review
description: Use for system design or changes affecting contracts, storage, security boundaries or production reliability.

name: test-and-verify
description: Use whenever code, configs, data pipelines or system behavior changes; enforce meaningful, reproducible quality checks.

name: secure-development
description: Use for all changes involving inputs, credentials, persistence, permissions, external access or sensitive data.

name: code-review
description: Use before merging changes to check correctness, maintainability, tests, security and adherence to project conventions.

name: pr-handoff
description: Use at the end of a feature, PR or deliverable to prepare trustworthy handoff and review.

name: incident-analysis
description: Use for operational incidents, outages, unexpected errors or postmortem drafting.

name: agent-factory
description: Use when creating, revising or retiring a reusable specialist agent within the hub.

name: skill-factory
description: Use when authoring or improving portable SKILL.md workflows and their supporting scripts or references.

name: api-design
description: Use when designing APIs, schemas and external or internal service contracts.

name: data-science
description: Use for statistical analysis, experiments, ML model development and reproducible research.

name: data-pipelines
description: Use for ETL, ingestion, transformations, analytics engineering and data quality.

name: sre-operations
description: Use for infra changes, reliability plans, monitoring, backup, deployment and incident prevention.

name: integration-contracts
description: Use when integrating APIs, webhooks, HL7, databases or external systems.

name: web-ui
description: Use when building frontend experiences, forms, data fetching and accessible component systems.
